note: Structure templates for kinetic-type films, in beats. Words are placeholders: the brief supplies every word, number and claim. 'scene' names a Studio scene kind from assets/motion-scenes or 'custom' with the move to build.

blocks.job: charge: the world or the question, small to huge
blocks.scene: custom: word slams with a rising push

blocks.job: drop: the hero word or the first key art
blocks.words: 2 words punched in over the picture

blocks.job: the promise, ending in a zoom through a letter
blocks.scene: custom: stack and split, zoom through a counter

blocks.job: second picture or proof
the action: a fly-through or accelerating beat cuts
the title in 3D type
the button: one gag or turn
end card: name, line, date or call to action
setup: the world or the problem
blocks.hit: low pulse, a hit every 4 beats

blocks.job: claims, outlined words that are not true yet
blocks.scene: custom: outlined type that fills on its beat

blocks.job: proof: what makes each claim true
escalation in half-beat cuts
blocks.scene: custom: cut run with ground flips on every cut

blocks.job: the title
blocks.scene: custom: zoom through a letter into the title

blocks.job: date or call to action
button and end card
the old way, in denials
the input that makes the result (a prompt, a brief, a tap)
blocks.scene: custom: typed line with a caret, ends in a push

blocks.job: drop: the product's name
three features, one 16-beat phrase each
blocks.words: a verb and an object per feature

blocks.job: one proof: a number the user supplies
blocks.hit: tick per digit, impact on the total

blocks.job: everything at once: a fast rewind of the film
blocks.scene: custom: earlier frames replayed at speed

blocks.job: name, line and call to action
what the audience cares about, as a question
the brand's answer
blocks.scene: custom: slam on the drop, then a slow push

blocks.job: three values or services, eight beats each
a quote or one proof
end card
